displayName: HireLoom: no successful crawl for 2 hours

documentation.content: No hireloom-crawler execution has succeeded in 2 hours, though it is scheduled every 20 minutes. Check that the Cloud Scheduler job hireloom-crawler-every-20m is enabled and that executions are not all failing.

conditionAbsent.filter: resource.type = "cloud_run_job" AND resource.labels.job_name = "hireloom-crawler" AND metric.type = "run.googleapis.com/job/completed_execution_count" AND metric.labels.result = "succeeded"
